build_residual_fn: build a residual function closure with pre-bound keyword arguments for system identification optimization
create_residual: create residuals by iterating over model-sequence groups and calling model_residual for each measured rollout
run_model_residual: run model_residual to compute weighted differences between predicted and measured sensor data from mujoco rollouts
construct_ts_from_defaults: construct time series by assembling predicted observations to match the measured signal layout
test_model_residual: test model_residual with custom rollout and custom residual modification callbacks for system identification
